newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan scraps sale of 30,000 T rice for export.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan scraps sale of 30,000 T rice for export.

text.p: The state-run Rice Export Corporation of Pakistan (RECP) on Sunday scrapped a tender for the sale and export of 30,000 tonnes of basmati rice grown in 1995/96 (July-June), an official said.
The RECP had received two bids, one at $421 per tonne FOB from Hamid al-Faris of Saudi Arabia and a lower one from a Pakistan-based firm, the official said.
Both were well below the $433.75 per tonne fetched at the last auction of 10,000 tonnes of basmati in August, he said.
Exporters said prices had dropped in anticipation of the arrival of the 1996/97 crop next month.
